correctness.rationale: Every depth-two tree is analyzed through the exact center-deletion join of star complexes and explicit center link; the three link homotopy cases exhaust all nonnegative branch sizes. Contractible link gives equivalence to the join; contractible deletion gives suspension of link. Integer augmentation lattices arise from unions of two contractible complexes meeting in isolated vertices; join Künneth is free integral, with Koszul sign +1 for swaps of degree-one factors. The 119 exhaustive finite mod-two checks and 11 signed Lefschetz checks corroborate distinct critical cases, not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural infinite family (all trees with diameter at most four), not arbitrary finite cases, receives exact integral homotopy, sharp contractibility thresholds, and its full canonical top automorphism lattice. This resolves a geometrically natural diameter-limited part of the explicit arbitrary-tree sphere-multiplicity question of Deshpande–Singh. Highly nonuniform branch sizes and the dichotomy between leaves and short arms are new structural information beyond the prior perfect m-ary special case.
